P1 · Planned — Smart missing-repository discovery

Validate read access for an explicitly requested unconfigured repository, report the result and offer a reviewed add-repository proposal.

P2 · Planned — Share tasks, chats and diary records

Prepare chosen formats for Teams/email or other apps, with explicit selection, redaction and user-controlled sending.

P1 · Planned — Portable structured export and import

Preserve chats, formatting, tasks, diary records, project/group hierarchy and references in a versioned importable package; secrets need separate consent/protection.

P2 · Done — Simplify workspace/project/group terminology

Workspace keeps separate data/settings; Project is the single chat-organizing label, with subprojects. Project pins stay ahead of subprojects; Recents sits below Projects. IDs, hierarchy and saved contents preserved; all seven workflows passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45556975855

P2 · Done — Explain the three-chat concurrency limit

Help explains three concurrent replies per workspace, one per chat, resource/rate-limit rationale and visible-chat Stop behavior. All seven workflows passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45571515851

P2 · Planned — Idle-time improvement and healing proposals

Design opt-in idle work with explicit action boundaries, validation and a separate activity history; uncertain or externally mutating work waits for required approval.

P1 · Planned — Per-section performance and improvement dashboard

Record measured before/after latency, throughput, tokens and resource metrics by section/change; separate real measurements from synthetic benchmarks.

P2 · Done — Initial chat naming and topic icon

First saved question assigns title and topic icon once. Manual names/icons and later questions preserve them; disabled automatic-icon mode retains titles. Integration tests and all seven workflows passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45571515851

P0 · Done — Default locks for To-do and My Diary updates

Already implemented and verified: locking, reopening/reload, edit/delete and completion guards. CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45531085801

P2 · Planned — Compare search, retrieval, analysis and visualisation

Use repeatable tasks and measurements to compare the reference Dashboard and AiMate; document gaps and prioritise improvements. Reference repository access remains required.

P3 · Planned — Daily Scrum Master voice assistant

Design an optional voice module for simple-English notes, clarification questions and available English voice/accent choices. Mic capture must be explicit; speech provider/access needs clarification before implementation.

P0 · Planned — Review a locally resolved reference Dashboard merge

Read-only pre-commit review in the existing repository/branch. Verify repository and merge state before proceeding; no unrelated repository changes, reset, merge or deployment.

Save the rule in skills/pluggable-features/SKILL.md and AGENTS.md; add registration/disable boundaries and enabled/disabled tests. Existing modules still need systematic decoupling.

Separate quality.yml passed with focused Python lint, syntax checks for all JavaScript sources and generated Pages/source consistency; all four test workflows also passed.

Repo skill saved in skills/aimate-backlog/SKILL.md and linked from AGENTS.md. It checks live/source To-dos, continues actionable priorities, asks only for genuine gaps and records evidence before completion. Skill validation and all seven workflows passed.

P1 · Planned — Intel AI connection options

Extend the verified Claude/GPT Bedrock connections with supported Gemini and gateway APIs. Codex, Cowork and OpenCode are client applications; require their non-secret API/endpoint instructions before claiming them as providers. Preserve current credentials and test each adapter separately.

P1 · Planned — Local offline AI fallback and cached context

Detect cloud authentication/network failures and offer an explicit local-model fallback. Keep local inference separate from connector internet access; use scoped cached evidence with freshness labels. Local runtime/model and laptop capabilities await user details.

P2 · Planned — Daily Jira-creation email digest

Prepare a reviewed daily summary of created Jira issues for a selected distribution list. Recipient, Jira scope, send time and approved mail service are required before scheduling or sending. No silent issue creation or email sends.

P2 · Done — Pin favorite chat messages

Saved user/reply star pins, paged Favorites view, Copy, original-chat navigation and Unpin implemented. Existing encrypted turn metadata preserves formatting and usage; backups restore pins, and deleting/editing away the turn removes its reference. Private/incomplete messages excluded. Enabled/disabled checks, 247 integration, 44 browser and nine backup tests passed; all seven workflows passed.
CI: https://github.com/abhijitxroy/aimate/actions/runs/45575134847

P1 · WIP — Inline formatting inside the askbar

User now requests bold formatting immediately in the editable askbar without Preview. Preserve source/selection, keyboard shortcuts, pasted text, copy, attachments and plain-editor fallback; implement and validate before completing.

P1 · WIP — OpenCode Bedrock connection

Use the supplied non-secret opencode.json: GPT, Claude, Kimi and GLM model catalog, fixed us-east-2 gateway routes and the shared Bedrock key. Integrate optional settings/adapter, validate supported protocols and tools, preserve saved credentials, and leave actual account/model access open until verified.

P1 · WIP — Dismiss confirmed repository prompts and preserve message order

Remove stale access-confirmation prompts, collapse repeated diagnostics under Activity and keep saved proposals with their original question/reply. Validate confirmation, reload and navigation races.

P2 · Planned — Message navigation rail

Slim topic-message markers, hover preview, click to jump and bookmark to existing Favorites, matching the supplied reference. Keep it optional, keyboard accessible, and isolated to the current conversation.
